Sidharth Malhotra Seeks Blessings at Lalbaugcha Raja

Actor Sidharth Malhotra visited the Lalbaugcha Raja Ganpati pandal in Mumbai. He was accompanied by producer Ektaa Kapoor. Malhotra was seen going barefoot as he sought blessings at the popular Ganesh idol. The visit occurred ahead of the release of the film 'Vvaan'.
